payload.text: Sweep additions (decision 93): each sweep commit also sets release.ci.workflow where the project's test workflow is not tests.yml (Gtools ci.yml; Conflab and Laksa at their adoption), and the sweep's message to each estate vc names the retired release publish verb (decision 107) and that the ci.query drop presumes WP02c's built-in default.
